previous_findings_closed: Medium finding from review2 (documentary Tisgav/Veyeetayu regression caused by the M1 direction-run break): closed. In reledmac.xslt, the note-direction-runs template (lines 4116–4129) now separates runs only when four things are all true: $separate is set (OSInstructionBlock only); the note has no non-whitespace direct text; it has at least one tei:foreign[@xml:lang]; and every child element is a tei:foreign[@xml:lang]. Every other note goes to the plain apply-templates branch, unchanged. A \newline is emitted only before the second and later foreign children, so a note that is one whole-span foreign child gets no break. Whitespace-only text nodes are skipped there, which is the 'trims structural whitespace' behaviour. An EN instruction with direct prose and one embedded he word fails the empty(text()[normalize-space()]) test, so it stays fully inline. This is the narrowing review2 asked for.
